meta.name: routeros-quickchr
meta.description: Ground RouterOS config/scripts/API code against a REAL router using quickchr (@tikoci/quickchr) — a CLI + Bun/TS library that downloads, boots, and manages MikroTik CHR VMs on QEMU. Use when: validating generated RouterOS config or scripts against real RouterOS before trusting them; spinning up a disposable CHR for REST/CLI/API iteration; writing integration/lab tests against CHR; needing host↔guest networking for a CHR (port-forward, L2/MNDP capture, guest→host UDP); driving an external RouterOS tool against a live CHR. For raw QEMU/CHR boot mechanics (VirtIO, UEFI vs SeaBIOS, acceleration) without quickchr, use routeros-qemu-chr instead.
